method: Pinned architecture tensor arithmetic, independently confirmed by CPU-only meta-device constructors; NOT trained weights, serving serialization, VRAM/RSS/latency measurement.
formula: V*H + L*(4*H^2 + 3*H*I) + (2*L+1)*H; first attention norm is identity, embeddings/final norms included; two biased Linear(H,2) heads = 2*(2*H+2). No MLM decoder or duplicate encoder.
workspace_warning: Attention arithmetic is a component estimate, not an allocator/total-memory upper bound. Whole-layer gradient checkpointing, microbatch1, sequential models; no clipping to satisfy a memory estimate.
ceilings_are: Proposed experiment budgets, NOT measured availability, allocation or performance. Validate after explicit handover; OOM/unsupported operator stops the arm, never silently changes recipe/truncates input.
deployment_weight_gate: Actual entire bundle <250000000 bytes. Approx136.3MB tensor arithmetic leaves room, NOT certification. Count graph initializers/constants, both heads, all distinct backbones/shards/external tensors; the273.9MB training checkpoint is NOT a compliant serving artifact.
runtime_validation: After authorization, verify CPU in-process FP16 operator support and parity against floating reference; measure cold/warm p50/p95, peak RSS, one/two concurrent calls and complete long inputs. INT8 is a separately frozen ablation, not an automatic fallback. Use admitted/local-approved inputs only; privacy/provenance holds are accounting, not a prediction panel. Any constructed long resource vectors are nonsemantic probes, never scored fresh examples. Measure a clean serving-only process separately from the larger FP32 reference/other experiments.

cpu_meta_preflight.method: CPU-only Torch meta-device constructors; no pretrained weight load, native input, forward call, optimizer, CUDA API or GPU access
cpu_meta_preflight.limits: Exact shape count only, not a training/serving memory, latency, serialization-size or quality measurement.

environment_provisioning: Dedicated local CPU-only environment successfully installed torch2.8.0+cpu, transformers5.20.2, tokenizers0.23.3. GPU build/driver/runtime not queried, installed or validated.

host_snapshot.qualification: Point-in-time host observation only; no resources reserved or workload cleared.

planned_disk_reservation_scope: 6GiB for sequential experiment outputs/checkpoints; package caches and environment provisioning reported separately; only current optimizer state and final models proposed, no claim that all intermediate checkpoints fit.
training_wall_time: UNMEASURED. Do not infer throughput from parameter count or earlier zero-shot CPU calls.
runtime_engine_scope: Pinned Torch CPU in-process reference/prototype validation is an OFFLINE proposal, not an approved Cria runtime dependency. The production stdlib-only contract remains in force. A compatible production engine/dependency architecture is unresolved and requires separate design/approval; no mandatory runtime package was added.
